object_description: Agent-designed two-tier serving trolley with 11 semantic parts; boxes estimated from a generated transparent reference.

parts.label: upper rectangular tray
parts.appearance: broad shallow rectangular basin with rounded corners, a flat horizontal bottom and low raised rim along all four edges, mounted at the top of the four posts

parts.label: lower rectangular tray
parts.appearance: broad shallow rectangular basin with rounded corners and a low raised perimeter rim, positioned horizontally near the bottom beneath the upper tray

parts.label: front left corner post
parts.appearance: straight slender cylindrical vertical shaft with circular cross-section, connecting the lower and upper trays at the front left corner and extending slightly below the lower tray

parts.label: rear left corner post
parts.appearance: straight slender cylindrical vertical shaft with circular cross-section, connecting the lower and upper trays at the rear left corner and extending slightly below the lower tray

parts.label: front right corner post
parts.appearance: straight slender cylindrical vertical shaft with circular cross-section, connecting the lower and upper trays at the front right corner and extending slightly below the lower tray

parts.label: rear right corner post
parts.appearance: straight slender cylindrical vertical shaft with circular cross-section, connecting the lower and upper trays at the rear right corner and extending slightly below the lower tray

parts.label: front left caster wheel
parts.appearance: thick round vertical disk with a recessed circular center and short fork-shaped bracket above, mounted below the front left corner post with its axle running front to back

parts.label: rear left caster wheel
parts.appearance: thick round vertical disk with a recessed circular center and short fork-shaped bracket above, mounted below the rear left corner post with its axle running front to back

parts.label: front right caster wheel
parts.appearance: thick round vertical disk with a recessed circular center and short fork-shaped bracket above, mounted below the front right corner post with its axle running front to back

parts.label: rear right caster wheel
parts.appearance: thick round vertical disk with a recessed circular center and short fork-shaped bracket above, mounted below the rear right corner post with its axle running front to back

parts.label: right end push handle
parts.appearance: single tall inverted U-shaped round tube with smoothly rounded upper corners, rising from the two right corner posts and bridging front to back above the upper tray
